_provenance.notes: v2 cut (feat/multi-community-band-reboot, ODD 2026-09-18): frequency / migrateCarrierFrequency / migratePriorCarrierFrequency re-pointed from rfFreqCarrier (1.3.6.1.4.1.161.19.3.1.1.2.0, STATUS deprecated, SYNTAX INTEGER { wired(0) } only) to radioFreqCarrier (whispApsRFConfigRadioEntry 1, INDEX radioIndex, 1.3.6.1.4.1.161.19.3.1.10.1.1.1.1 for radioIndex=1, STATUS current, MAX-ACCESS read-write). Added eirp (.306 whispBoxActiveEIRP), activeTxPowerDbh (.233 whispBoxActiveTxPowerInHundredthsDbm), smSnrH (.84 linkRadioAggrSmHCalculatedSnr), and ssrLink (.86 linkRadioAggrSignalStrengthRatio).
